sections.content_text: Section 116 - Deductions of Tax from Commission or Remuneration Paid to Foreign Buyer's Agent Where, under the terms of a letter of credit or under any instruction an exporter makes payment for the export of goods through a bank, makes payment to an agent any amount from the export of the goods as commission, charge or remuneration, represents a foreign buyer or by whatever name it may be called, the Bank shall deduct or collect advance tax at the rate of 10% (ten percent) at the time payment of commission, charge or remuneration.
